title: Мої пропозиції архіву
fields_and_relations: kind=change_proposal, ціль/версія, автор, відповідь і стан.
required_interaction: Подати/доопрацювати/читати рішення; author-view PG-24 без accept-повноваження.

implementation.view_model: Owned typed description/classification/relation proposals; immutable evidence basis, rationale, reviewer response, defer/rework/replacement history; source unchanged on submission.
limitations: Browser-local workflow; controlled related_to/variant_of relations, no automatic acceptance.
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v9; existing state and legacy proposals preserved.
permissions: research.write in an explicit archive grant
domain.read rechecked for every source, note, assertion, citation and download
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, compare expected corpus/assertion revision, mutate clone, validate exact FK/versions and immutable corpus membership hashes, commit once.
